name: International Journal of Molecular Sciences (IJMS)

official_rule_sources.access: official indexed text; live request HTTP 429

official_rule_sources.scope: publisher-wide recommendation; not an IJMS-specific hard minimum

official_requirements.figure_numbering: Sequential; near first mention; caption explains panels and symbols.
official_requirements.color: RGB, 8 bit per channel is encouraged in the indexed instructions.
official_requirements.additional_figure_file_resolution: Minimum 1000 pixels width/height OR resolution 300 dpi or higher in indexed instructions.
official_requirements.graphical_abstract: Separate asset: do not equate its requirements with a main-text figure.

internal_targets.width_policy: Read actual manuscript column/text width; do not impose a global 8/14/17 cm rule.
internal_targets.font: One installed, verified sans-serif family; preserve gene/taxon italics.
internal_targets.evidence_encoding: Reported effect, proposed/indirect relationship, reaction, transport and context are distinct.

refresh_policy: Recheck official instructions for a new final-delivery cycle. If access fails, record the source/date and limitation; never invent a new hard rule or claim live certification.
template_policy: Use the supplied official Word template or a verified local TeX skeleton. A safe generic TeX builder does not automatically support the MDPI class.
